[452](https://landlock.io#452)
[453](https://landlock.io#453)impl Compatibility {
[454](https://landlock.io#454)    // Compatibility is a semi-opaque struct.
[455](https://landlock.io#455)    #[allow(clippy::new_without_default)]
[456](https://landlock.io#456)    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
[457](https://landlock.io#457)        LandlockStatus::current().into()
[458](https://landlock.io#458)    }
[459](https://landlock.io#459)
[460](https://landlock.io#460)    pub(crate) fn update(&mut self, state: CompatState) {
[461](https://landlock.io#461)        self.state.update(state);
[462](https://landlock.io#462)    }
[463](https://landlock.io#463)
[464](https://landlock.io#464)    pub(crate) fn abi(&self) -> ABI {
[465](https://landlock.io#465)        self.status.into()
[466](https://landlock.io#466)    }
[467](https://landlock.io#467)
[468](https://landlock.io#468)    pub(crate) fn status(&self) -> LandlockStatus {
[469](https://landlock.io#469)        self.status
[470](https://landlock.io#470)    }
[471](https://landlock.io#471)
[472](https://landlock.io#472)    /// Handles the compat dispatch for a binary supported/not-supported check.
[473](https://landlock.io#473)    ///
[474](https://landlock.io#474)    /// This is factored out from the No branch of
[475](https://landlock.io#475)    /// [`TryCompat::try_compat()`](crate::TryCompat::try_compat) for use by
[476](https://landlock.io#476)    /// [`SyscallFlagExt::try_compat()`](crate::flags::SyscallFlagExt::try_compat),
[477](https://landlock.io#477)    /// where a single flag is either fully supported or not (no Partial case).
[478](https://landlock.io#478)    ///
[479](https://landlock.io#479)    /// Returns `Ok(true)` if supported (caller should apply the flag),
[480](https://landlock.io#480)    /// `Ok(false)` if unsupported but acceptable
[481](https://landlock.io#481)    /// ([`BestEffort`](crate::CompatLevel::BestEffort) /
[482](https://landlock.io#482)    /// [`SoftRequirement`](crate::CompatLevel::SoftRequirement)), or `Err` if
[483](https://landlock.io#483)    /// unsupported with [`HardRequirement`](crate::CompatLevel::HardRequirement).
[484](https://landlock.io#484)    pub(crate) fn try_compat_binary<E, F>(
[485](https://landlock.io#485)        &mut self,
[486](https://landlock.io#486)        supported: bool,
[487](https://landlock.io#487)        make_error: F,
[488](https://landlock.io#488)    ) -> Result<bool, E>
[489](https://landlock.io#489)    where
[490](https://landlock.io#490)        F: FnOnce() -> E,
[491](https://landlock.io#491)    {
[492](https://landlock.io#492)        if supported {
[493](https://landlock.io#493)            self.state.update(CompatState::Full);
[494](https://landlock.io#494)            Ok(true)
[495](https://landlock.io#495)        } else {
[496](https://landlock.io#496)            match self.level.into() {
[497](https://landlock.io#497)                CompatLevel::BestEffort => {
[498](https://landlock.io#498)                    self.state.update(CompatState::No);
[499](https://landlock.io#499)                    Ok(false)
[500](https://landlock.io#500)                }
[501](https://landlock.io#501)                CompatLevel::SoftRequirement => {
[502](https://landlock.io#502)                    self.state.update(CompatState::Dummy);
[503](https://landlock.io#503)                    Ok(false)
[504](https://landlock.io#504)                }
[505](https://landlock.io#505)                CompatLevel::HardRequirement => Err(make_error()),
[506](https://landlock.io#506)            }
[507](https://landlock.io#507)        }
[508](https://landlock.io#508)    }
[509](https://landlock.io#509)}
[510](https://landlock.io#510)
[511](https://landlock.io#511)pub(crate) mod private {
[512](https://landlock.io#512)    use crate::CompatLevel;
[513](https://landlock.io#513)
[514](https://landlock.io#514)    pub trait OptionCompatLevelMut {
[515](https://landlock.io#515)        fn as_option_compat_level_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Option<CompatLevel>;
[516](https://landlock.io#516)    }
[517](https://landlock.io#517)}
[518](https://landlock.io#518)
[519](https://landlock.io#519)/// Properly handles runtime unsupported features.
[520](https://landlock.io#520)///
[521](https://landlock.io#521)/// This guarantees consistent behaviors across crate users
[522](https://landlock.io#522)/// and runtime kernels even if this crate get new features.
[523](https://landlock.io#523)/// It eases backward compatibility and enables future-proofness.
[524](https://landlock.io#524)///
[525](https://landlock.io#525)/// Landlock is a security feature designed to help improve security of a running system
[526](https://landlock.io#526)/// thanks to application developers.
[527](https://landlock.io#527)/// To protect users as much as possible,
[528](https://landlock.io#528)/// compatibility with the running system should then be handled in a best-effort way,
[529](https://landlock.io#529)/// contrary to common system features.
[530](https://landlock.io#530)/// In some circumstances
[531](https://landlock.io#531)/// (e.g. applications carefully designed to only be run with a specific set of kernel features),
[532](https://landlock.io#532)/// it may be required to error out if some of these features are not available
[533](https://landlock.io#533)/// and will then not be enforced.
[534](https://landlock.io#534)pub trait Compatible: Sized + private::OptionCompatLevelMut {
[535](https://landlock.io#535)    /// To enable a best-effort security approach,
[536](https://landlock.io#536)    /// Landlock features that are not supported by the running system
[537](https://landlock.io#537)    /// are silently ignored by default,
[538](https://landlock.io#538)    /// which is a sane choice for most use cases.
[539](https://landlock.io#539)    /// However, on some rare circumstances,
[540](https://landlock.io#540)    /// developers may want to have some guarantees that their applications
[541](https://landlock.io#541)    /// will not run if a certain level of sandboxing is not possible.
[542](https://landlock.io#542)    /// If we really want to error out when not all our requested requirements are met,
[543](https://landlock.io#543)    /// then we can configure it with `set_compatibility()`.
[544](https://landlock.io#544)    ///
[545](https://landlock.io#545)    /// The `Compatible` trait is implemented for all object builders
[546](https://landlock.io#546)    /// (e.g. [`Ruleset`](crate::Ruleset)).
[547](https://landlock.io#547)    /// Such builders have a set of methods to incrementally build an object.
[548](https://landlock.io#548)    /// These build methods rely on kernel features that may not be available at runtime.
[549](https://landlock.io#549)    /// The `set_compatibility()` method enables to control the effect of
[550](https://landlock.io#550)    /// the following build method calls starting after the `set_compatibility()` call.
[551](https://landlock.io#551)    /// Such effect can be:
[552](https://landlock.io#552)    /// * to silently ignore unsupported features
[553](https://landlock.io#553)    ///   and continue building ([`CompatLevel::BestEffort`]);
[554](https://landlock.io#554)    /// * to silently ignore unsupported features
[555](https://landlock.io#555)    ///   and ignore the whole build ([`CompatLevel::SoftRequirement`]);
[556](https://landlock.io#556)    /// * to return an error for any unsupported feature ([`CompatLevel::HardRequirement`]).
[557](https://landlock.io#557)    ///
[558](https://landlock.io#558)    /// Taking [`Ruleset`](crate::Ruleset) as an example,
[559](https://landlock.io#559)    /// the [`handle_access()`](crate::RulesetAttr::handle_access()) build method
[560](https://landlock.io#560)    /// returns a [`Result`] that can be [`Err(RulesetError)`](crate::RulesetError)
[561](https://landlock.io#561)    /// with a nested [`CompatError`].
[562](https://landlock.io#562)    /// Such error can only occur with a running Linux kernel not supporting the requested
[563](https://landlock.io#563)    /// Landlock accesses *and* if the current compatibility level is
[564](https://landlock.io#564)    /// [`CompatLevel::HardRequirement`].
[565](https://landlock.io#565)    /// However, such error is not possible with [`CompatLevel::BestEffort`]
[566](https://landlock.io#566)    /// nor [`CompatLevel::SoftRequirement`].
[567](https://landlock.io#567)    ///
[568](https://landlock.io#568)    /// The order of this call is important because
[569](https://landlock.io#569)    /// it defines the behavior of the following build method calls that return a [`Result`].
[570](https://landlock.io#570)    /// If `set_compatibility(CompatLevel::HardRequirement)` is called on an object,
[571](https://landlock.io#571)    /// then a [`CompatError`] may be returned for the next method calls,
[572](https://landlock.io#572)    /// until the next call to `set_compatibility()`.
[573](https://landlock.io#573)    /// This enables to change the behavior of a set of build method calls,
[574](https://landlock.io#574)    /// for instance to be sure that the sandbox will at least restrict some access rights.
[575](https://landlock.io#575)    ///
[576](https://landlock.io#576)    /// New objects inherit the compatibility configuration of their parents, if any.
[577](https://landlock.io#577)    /// For instance, [`Ruleset::create()`](crate::Ruleset::create()) returns
[578](https://landlock.io#578)    /// a [`RulesetCreated`](crate::RulesetCreated) object that inherits the
[579](https://landlock.io#579)    /// `Ruleset`'s compatibility configuration.
[580](https://landlock.io#580)    ///
[581](https://landlock.io#581)    /// # Example with `SoftRequirement`
[582](https://landlock.io#582)    ///
[583](https://landlock.io#583)    /// Let's say an application legitimately needs to rename files between directories.
[584](https://landlock.io#584)    /// Because of [previous Landlock limitations](https://docs.kernel.org/userspace-api/landlock.html#file-renaming-and-linking-abi-2),
[585](https://landlock.io#585)    /// this was forbidden with the [first version of Landlock](ABI::V1),
[586](https://landlock.io#586)    /// but it is now handled starting with the [second version](ABI::V2).
[587](https://landlock.io#587)    /// For this use case, we only want the application to be sandboxed
[588](https://landlock.io#588)    /// if we have the guarantee that it will not break a legitimate usage (i.e. rename files).
[589](https://landlock.io#589)    /// We then create a ruleset which will either support file renaming
[590](https://landlock.io#590)    /// (thanks to [`AccessFs::Refer`](crate::AccessFs::Refer)) or silently do nothing.
[591](https://landlock.io#591)    ///
[592](https://landlock.io#592)    /// ```
[593](https://landlock.io#593)    /// use landlock::*;
[594](https://landlock.io#594)    ///
[595](https://landlock.io#595)    /// fn ruleset_handling_renames() -> Result<RulesetCreated, RulesetError> {
[596](https://landlock.io#596)    ///     Ok(Ruleset::default()
[597](https://landlock.io#597)    ///         // This ruleset must either handle the AccessFs::Refer right,
[598](https://landlock.io#598)    ///         // or it must silently ignore the whole sandboxing.
[599](https://landlock.io#599)    ///         .set_compatibility(CompatLevel::SoftRequirement)
[600](https://landlock.io#600)    ///         .handle_access(AccessFs::Refer)?
[601](https://landlock.io#601)    ///         // However, this ruleset may also handle other (future) access rights
[602](https://landlock.io#602)    ///         // if they are supported by the running kernel.
[603](https://landlock.io#603)    ///         .set_compatibility(CompatLevel::BestEffort)
[604](https://landlock.io#604)    ///         .handle_access(AccessFs::from_all(ABI::V7))?
[605](https://landlock.io#605)    ///         .create()?)
[606](https://landlock.io#606)    /// }
[607](https://landlock.io#607)    /// ```
[608](https://landlock.io#608)    ///
[609](https://landlock.io#609)    /// # Example with `HardRequirement`
[610](https://landlock.io#610)    ///
[611](https://landlock.io#611)    /// Security-dedicated applications may want to ensure that
[612](https://landlock.io#612)    /// an untrusted software component is subject to a minimum of restrictions before launching it.
[613](https://landlock.io#613)    /// In this case, we want to create a ruleset which will at least support
[614](https://landlock.io#614)    /// all restrictions provided by the [first version of Landlock](ABI::V1),
[615](https://landlock.io#615)    /// and opportunistically handle restrictions supported by newer kernels.
[616](https://landlock.io#616)    ///
[617](https://landlock.io#617)    /// ```
[618](https://landlock.io#618)    /// use landlock::*;
[619](https://landlock.io#619)    ///
[620](https://landlock.io#620)    /// fn ruleset_fragile() -> Result<RulesetCreated, RulesetError> {
[621](https://landlock.io#621)    ///     Ok(Ruleset::default()
[622](https://landlock.io#622)    ///         // This ruleset must either handle at least all accesses defined by
[623](https://landlock.io#623)    ///         // the first Landlock version (e.g. AccessFs::WriteFile),
[624](https://landlock.io#624)    ///         // or the following handle_access() call must return a wrapped
[625](https://landlock.io#625)    ///         // AccessError<AccessFs>::Incompatible error.
[626](https://landlock.io#626)    ///         .set_compatibility(CompatLevel::HardRequirement)
[627](https://landlock.io#627)    ///         .handle_access(AccessFs::from_all(ABI::V1))?
[628](https://landlock.io#628)    ///         // However, this ruleset may also handle new access rights
[629](https://landlock.io#629)    ///         // (e.g. AccessFs::Refer defined by the second version of Landlock)
[630](https://landlock.io#630)    ///         // if they are supported by the running kernel,
[631](https://landlock.io#631)    ///         // but without returning any error otherwise.
[632](https://landlock.io#632)    ///         .set_compatibility(CompatLevel::BestEffort)
[633](https://landlock.io#633)    ///         .handle_access(AccessFs::from_all(ABI::V7))?
[634](https://landlock.io#634)    ///         .create()?)
[635](https://landlock.io#635)    /// }
[636](https://landlock.io#636)    /// ```
[637](https://landlock.io#637)    fn set_compatibility(mut self, level: CompatLevel) -> Self {
[638](https://landlock.io#638)        *self.as_option_compat_level_mut() = Some(level);
[639](https://landlock.io#639)        self
[640](https://landlock.io#640)    }
[641](https://landlock.io#641)
[642](https://landlock.io#642)    /// Cf. [`set_compatibility()`](Compatible::set_compatibility()):
[643](https://landlock.io#643)    ///
[644](https://landlock.io#644)    /// - `set_best_effort(true)` translates to `set_compatibility(CompatLevel::BestEffort)`.
[645](https://landlock.io#645)    ///
[646](https://landlock.io#646)    /// - `set_best_effort(false)` translates to `set_compatibility(CompatLevel::HardRequirement)`.
[647](https://landlock.io#647)    #[deprecated(note = "Use set_compatibility() instead")]
[648](https://landlock.io#648)    fn set_best_effort(self, best_effort: bool) -> Self
[649](https://landlock.io#649)    where
[650](https://landlock.io#650)        Self: Sized,
[651](https://landlock.io#651)    {
[652](https://landlock.io#652)        self.set_compatibility(match best_effort {
[653](https://landlock.io#653)            true => CompatLevel::BestEffort,
[654](https://landlock.io#654)            false => CompatLevel::HardRequirement,
[655](https://landlock.io#655)        })
[656](https://landlock.io#656)    }
[657](https://landlock.io#657)}
[658](https://landlock.io#658)
[659](https://landlock.io#659)#[test]
[660](https://landlock.io#660)#[allow(deprecated)]
[661](https://landlock.io#661)fn deprecated_set_best_effort() {
[662](https://landlock.io#662)    use crate::{CompatLevel, Compatible, Ruleset};
[663](https://landlock.io#663)
[664](https://landlock.io#664)    assert_eq!(
[665](https://landlock.io#665)        Ruleset::default().set_best_effort(true).compat,
[666](https://landlock.io#666)        Ruleset::default()
[667](https://landlock.io#667)            .set_compatibility(CompatLevel::BestEffort)
[668](https://landlock.io#668)            .compat
[669](https://landlock.io#669)    );
[670](https://landlock.io#670)    assert_eq!(
[671](https://landlock.io#671)        Ruleset::default().set_best_effort(false).compat,
[672](https://landlock.io#672)        Ruleset::default()
[673](https://landlock.io#673)            .set_compatibility(CompatLevel::HardRequirement)
[674](https://landlock.io#674)            .compat
[675](https://landlock.io#675)    );
[676](https://landlock.io#676)}
[677](https://landlock.io#677)
[678](https://landlock.io#678)/// See the [`Compatible`] documentation.
[679](https://landlock.io#679)#[cfg_attr(test, derive(EnumIter))]
[680](https://landlock.io#680)#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
[681](https://landlock.io#681)pub enum CompatLevel {
[682](https://landlock.io#682)    /// Takes into account the build requests if they are supported by the running system,
[683](https://landlock.io#683)    /// or silently ignores them otherwise.
[684](https://landlock.io#684)    /// Never returns a compatibility error.
[685](https://landlock.io#685)    #[default]
[686](https://landlock.io#686)    BestEffort,
[687](https://landlock.io#687)    /// Takes into account the build requests if they are supported by the running system,
[688](https://landlock.io#688)    /// or silently ignores the whole build object otherwise.
[689](https://landlock.io#689)    /// Never returns a compatibility error.
[690](https://landlock.io#690)    /// If not supported,
[691](https://landlock.io#691)    /// the call to [`RulesetCreated::restrict_self()`](crate::RulesetCreated::restrict_self())
[692](https://landlock.io#692)    /// will return a
[693](https://landlock.io#693)    /// [`RestrictionStatus { ruleset: RulesetStatus::NotEnforced, no_new_privs: false, }`](crate::RestrictionStatus).
[694](https://landlock.io#694)    SoftRequirement,
[695](https://landlock.io#695)    /// Takes into account the build requests if they are supported by the running system,
[696](https://landlock.io#696)    /// or returns a compatibility error otherwise ([`CompatError`]).
[697](https://landlock.io#697)    HardRequirement,
[698](https://landlock.io#698)}
[699](https://landlock.io#699)
[700](https://landlock.io#700)impl From<Option<CompatLevel>> for CompatLevel {
[701](https://landlock.io#701)    fn from(opt: Option<CompatLevel>) -> Self {
[702](https://landlock.io#702)        match opt {
[703](https://landlock.io#703)            None => CompatLevel::default(),
[704](https://landlock.io#704)            Some(ref level) => *level,
[705](https://landlock.io#705)        }
[706](https://landlock.io#706)    }
[707](https://landlock.io#707)}
[708](https://landlock.io#708)
[709](https://landlock.io#709)// TailoredCompatLevel could be replaced with AsMut<Option<CompatLevel>>, but only traits defined
[710](https://landlock.io#710)// in the current crate can be implemented for types defined outside of the crate.  Furthermore it
[711](https://landlock.io#711)// provides a default implementation which is handy for types such as BitFlags.
[712](https://landlock.io#712)pub trait TailoredCompatLevel {
[713](https://landlock.io#713)    fn tailored_compat_level<L>(&mut self, parent_level: L) -> CompatLevel
[714](https://landlock.io#714)    where
[715](https://landlock.io#715)        L: Into<CompatLevel>,
[716](https://landlock.io#716)    {
[717](https://landlock.io#717)        parent_level.into()
[718](https://landlock.io#718)    }
[719](https://landlock.io#719)}
[720](https://landlock.io#720)
[721](https://landlock.io#721)impl<T> TailoredCompatLevel for T
[722](https://landlock.io#722)where
[723](https://landlock.io#723)    Self: Compatible,
[724](https://landlock.io#724){
[725](https://landlock.io#725)    // Every Compatible trait implementation returns its own compatibility level, if set.
[726](https://landlock.io#726)    fn tailored_compat_level<L>(&mut self, parent_level: L) -> CompatLevel
[727](https://landlock.io#727)    where
[728](https://landlock.io#728)        L: Into<CompatLevel>,
[729](https://landlock.io#729)    {
[730](https://landlock.io#730)        // Using a mutable reference is not required but it makes the code simpler (no double AsRef
[731](https://landlock.io#731)        // implementations for each Compatible types), and more importantly it guarantees
[732](https://landlock.io#732)        // consistency with Compatible::set_compatibility().
[733](https://landlock.io#733)        match self.as_option_compat_level_mut() {
[734](https://landlock.io#734)            None => parent_level.into(),
[735](https://landlock.io#735)            // Returns the most constrained compatibility level.
[736](https://landlock.io#736)            Some(ref level) => parent_level.into().max(*level),
[737](https://landlock.io#737)        }
[738](https://landlock.io#738)    }
[739](https://landlock.io#739)}
[740](https://landlock.io#740)
[741](https://landlock.io#741)#[test]
[742](https://landlock.io#742)fn tailored_compat_level() {
[743](https://landlock.io#743)    use crate::{AccessFs, PathBeneath, PathFd};
[744](https://landlock.io#744)
[745](https://landlock.io#745)    fn new_path(level: CompatLevel) -> PathBeneath<PathFd> {
[746](https://landlock.io#746)        PathBeneath::new(PathFd::new("/").unwrap(), AccessFs::Execute).set_compatibility(level)
[747](https://landlock.io#747)    }
[748](https://landlock.io#748)
[749](https://landlock.io#749)    for parent_level in CompatLevel::iter() {
[750](https://landlock.io#750)        assert_eq!(
[751](https://landlock.io#751)            new_path(CompatLevel::BestEffort).tailored_compat_level(parent_level),
[752](https://landlock.io#752)            parent_level
[753](https://landlock.io#753)        );
[754](https://landlock.io#754)        assert_eq!(
[755](https://landlock.io#755)            new_path(CompatLevel::HardRequirement).tailored_compat_level(parent_level),
[756](https://landlock.io#756)            CompatLevel::HardRequirement
[757](https://landlock.io#757)        );
[758](https://landlock.io#758)    }
[759](https://landlock.io#759)
[760](https://landlock.io#760)    assert_eq!(
[761](https://landlock.io#761)        new_path(CompatLevel::SoftRequirement).tailored_compat_level(CompatLevel::SoftRequirement),
[762](https://landlock.io#762)        CompatLevel::SoftRequirement
[763](https://landlock.io#763)    );
[764](https://landlock.io#764)
[765](https://landlock.io#765)    for child_level in CompatLevel::iter() {
[766](https://landlock.io#766)        assert_eq!(
[767](https://landlock.io#767)            new_path(child_level).tailored_compat_level(CompatLevel::BestEffort),
[768](https://landlock.io#768)            child_level
[769](https://landlock.io#769)        );
[770](https://landlock.io#770)        assert_eq!(
[771](https://landlock.io#771)            new_path(child_level).tailored_compat_level(CompatLevel::HardRequirement),
[772](https://landlock.io#772)            CompatLevel::HardRequirement
[773](https://landlock.io#773)        );
[774](https://landlock.io#774)    }
[775](https://landlock.io#775)}
[776](https://landlock.io#776)
[777](https://landlock.io#777)// CompatResult is not public outside this crate.
[778](https://landlock.io#778)pub enum CompatResult<A>
[779](https://landlock.io#779)where
[780](https://landlock.io#780)    A: Access,
[781](https://landlock.io#781){
[782](https://landlock.io#782)    // Fully matches the request.
[783](https://landlock.io#783)    Full,
[784](https://landlock.io#784)    // Partially matches the request.
[785](https://landlock.io#785)    Partial(CompatError<A>),
[786](https://landlock.io#786)    // Doesn't matches the request.
[787](https://landlock.io#787)    No(CompatError<A>),
[788](https://landlock.io#788)}
[789](https://landlock.io#789)
[790](https://landlock.io#790)// TryCompat is not public outside this crate.
[791](https://landlock.io#791)pub trait TryCompat<A>
[792](https://landlock.io#792)where
[793](https://landlock.io#793)    Self: Sized + TailoredCompatLevel,
[794](https://landlock.io#794)    A: Access,
[795](https://landlock.io#795){
[796](https://landlock.io#796)    fn try_compat_inner(&mut self, abi: ABI) -> Result<CompatResult<A>, CompatError<A>>;
[797](https://landlock.io#797)
[798](https://landlock.io#798)    // Default implementation for objects without children.
[799](https://landlock.io#799)    //
[800](https://landlock.io#800)    // If returning something other than Ok(Some(self)), the implementation must use its own
[801](https://landlock.io#801)    // compatibility level, if any, with self.tailored_compat_level(default_compat_level), and pass
[802](https://landlock.io#802)    // it with the abi and compat_state to each child.try_compat().  See PathBeneath implementation
[803](https://landlock.io#803)    // and the self.allowed_access.try_compat() call.
[804](https://landlock.io#804)    //
[805](https://landlock.io#805)    // # Warning
[806](https://landlock.io#806)    //
[807](https://landlock.io#807)    // Errors must be prioritized over incompatibility (i.e. return Err(e) over Ok(None)) for all
[808](https://landlock.io#808)    // children.
[809](https://landlock.io#809)    fn try_compat_children<L>(
[810](https://landlock.io#810)        self,
[811](https://landlock.io#811)        _abi: ABI,
[812](https://landlock.io#812)        _parent_level: L,
[813](https://landlock.io#813)        _compat_state: &mut CompatState,
[814](https://landlock.io#814)    ) -> Result<Option<Self>, CompatError<A>>
[815](https://landlock.io#815)    where
[816](https://landlock.io#816)        L: Into<CompatLevel>,
[817](https://landlock.io#817)    {
[818](https://landlock.io#818)        Ok(Some(self))
[819](https://landlock.io#819)    }
[820](https://landlock.io#820)
[821](https://landlock.io#821)    // Update compat_state and return an error according to try_compat_*() error, or to the
[822](https://landlock.io#822)    // compatibility level, i.e. either route compatible object or error.
[823](https://landlock.io#823)    fn try_compat<L>(
[824](https://landlock.io#824)        mut self,
[825](https://landlock.io#825)        abi: ABI,
[826](https://landlock.io#826)        parent_level: L,
[827](https://landlock.io#827)        compat_state: &mut CompatState,
[828](https://landlock.io#828)    ) -> Result<Option<Self>, CompatError<A>>
[829](https://landlock.io#829)    where
[830](https://landlock.io#830)        L: Into<CompatLevel>,
[831](https://landlock.io#831)    {
[832](https://landlock.io#832)        let compat_level = self.tailored_compat_level(parent_level);
[833](https://landlock.io#833)        let some_inner = match self.try_compat_inner(abi) {
[834](https://landlock.io#834)            Ok(CompatResult::Full) => {
[835](https://landlock.io#835)                compat_state.update(CompatState::Full);
[836](https://landlock.io#836)                true
[837](https://landlock.io#837)            }
[838](https://landlock.io#838)            Ok(CompatResult::Partial(error)) => match compat_level {
[839](https://landlock.io#839)                CompatLevel::BestEffort => {
[840](https://landlock.io#840)                    compat_state.update(CompatState::Partial);
[841](https://landlock.io#841)                    true
[842](https://landlock.io#842)                }
[843](https://landlock.io#843)                CompatLevel::SoftRequirement => {
[844](https://landlock.io#844)                    compat_state.update(CompatState::Dummy);
[845](https://landlock.io#845)                    false
[846](https://landlock.io#846)                }
[847](https://landlock.io#847)                CompatLevel::HardRequirement => {
[848](https://landlock.io#848)                    compat_state.update(CompatState::Dummy);
[849](https://landlock.io#849)                    return Err(error);
[850](https://landlock.io#850)                }
[851](https://landlock.io#851)            },
[852](https://landlock.io#852)            Ok(CompatResult::No(error)) => match compat_level {
[853](https://landlock.io#853)                CompatLevel::BestEffort => {
[854](https://landlock.io#854)                    compat_state.update(CompatState::No);
[855](https://landlock.io#855)                    false
[856](https://landlock.io#856)                }
[857](https://landlock.io#857)                CompatLevel::SoftRequirement => {
[858](https://landlock.io#858)                    compat_state.update(CompatState::Dummy);
[859](https://landlock.io#859)                    false
[860](https://landlock.io#860)                }
[861](https://landlock.io#861)                CompatLevel::HardRequirement => {
[862](https://landlock.io#862)                    compat_state.update(CompatState::Dummy);
[863](https://landlock.io#863)                    return Err(error);
[864](https://landlock.io#864)                }
[865](https://landlock.io#865)            },
[866](https://landlock.io#866)            Err(error) => {
[867](https://landlock.io#867)                // Safeguard to help for test consistency.
[868](https://landlock.io#868)                compat_state.update(CompatState::Dummy);
[869](https://landlock.io#869)                return Err(error);
[870](https://landlock.io#870)            }
[871](https://landlock.io#871)        };
[872](https://landlock.io#872)
[873](https://landlock.io#873)        // At this point, any inner error have been returned, so we can proceed with
[874](https://landlock.io#874)        // try_compat_children()?.
[875](https://landlock.io#875)        match self.try_compat_children(abi, compat_level, compat_state)? {
[876](https://landlock.io#876)            Some(n) if some_inner => Ok(Some(n)),
[877](https://landlock.io#877)            _ => Ok(None),
[878](https://landlock.io#878)        }
[879](https://landlock.io#879)    }
[880](https://landlock.io#880)}

---

# errata.rs - source

Source: https://landlock.io/rust-landlock/src/landlock/errata.rs.html

# landlock/errata.rs

[1](https://landlock.io#1)// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
[2](https://landlock.io#2)
[3](https://landlock.io#3)use crate::compat::ABI;
[4](https://landlock.io#4)use crate::{uapi, BitFlags};
[5](https://landlock.io#5)use enumflags2::bitflags;
[6](https://landlock.io#6)
[7](https://landlock.io#7)/// Fixed kernel issues for the running Landlock implementation.
[8](https://landlock.io#8)///
[9](https://landlock.io#9)/// Each variant represents a specific bug fix that may have been
[10](https://landlock.io#10)/// backported to the running kernel.  Use [`Erratum::current()`]
[11](https://landlock.io#11)/// before building a [`Ruleset`](crate::Ruleset) to decide which
[12](https://landlock.io#12)/// features are safe to use.
[13](https://landlock.io#13)///
[14](https://landlock.io#14)/// An [`ABI`] version can be converted into the set of applicable errata
[15](https://landlock.io#15)/// with `BitFlags::<Erratum>::from(abi)`.
[16](https://landlock.io#16)///
[17](https://landlock.io#17)/// # Warning
[18](https://landlock.io#18)///
[19](https://landlock.io#19)/// Most applications should **not** check errata.  Disabling a sandboxing
[20](https://landlock.io#20)/// feature because an erratum is not fixed could leave the system **less**
[21](https://landlock.io#21)/// secure than using Landlock's best-effort protection with the buggy
[22](https://landlock.io#22)/// feature enabled.  Errata should only be used to **add** features
[23](https://landlock.io#23)/// (e.g., enabling a restriction only when its bug is confirmed fixed),
[24](https://landlock.io#24)/// never to remove them.
[25](https://landlock.io#25)#[bitflags]
[26](https://landlock.io#26)#[repr(u32)]
[27](https://landlock.io#27)#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
[28](https://landlock.io#28)#[non_exhaustive]
[29](https://landlock.io#29)pub enum Erratum {
[30](https://landlock.io#30)    /// Erratum 1 (ABI 4): non-TCP stream sockets (SMC, MPTCP, SCTP)
[31](https://landlock.io#31)    /// were incorrectly restricted by TCP access rights during
[32](https://landlock.io#32)    /// `bind(2)` and `connect(2)`.
[33](https://landlock.io#33)    ///
[34](https://landlock.io#34)    /// Affects [`crate::AccessNet::BindTcp`] and [`crate::AccessNet::ConnectTcp`].
[35](https://landlock.io#35)    ///
[36](https://landlock.io#36)    /// See [erratum 1](https://docs.kernel.org/userspace-api/landlock.html#erratum-1-tcp-socket-identification).
[37](https://landlock.io#37)    TcpSocketIdentification = 1 << 0,
[38](https://landlock.io#38)    /// Erratum 2 (ABI 6): signal scoping was overly restrictive,
[39](https://landlock.io#39)    /// preventing sandboxed threads from signaling other threads
[40](https://landlock.io#40)    /// within the same process in different domains.
[41](https://landlock.io#41)    ///
[42](https://landlock.io#42)    /// Affects [`crate::Scope::Signal`].
[43](https://landlock.io#43)    ///
[44](https://landlock.io#44)    /// See [erratum 2](https://docs.kernel.org/userspace-api/landlock.html#erratum-2-scoped-signal-handling).
[45](https://landlock.io#45)    ScopedSignalHandling = 1 << 1,
[46](https://landlock.io#46)    /// Erratum 3 (ABI 1): access rights could be widened through
[47](https://landlock.io#47)    /// rename or link actions on disconnected directories under
[48](https://landlock.io#48)    /// bind mounts, potentially bypassing `LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_REFER`
[49](https://landlock.io#49)    /// restrictions.
[50](https://landlock.io#50)    ///
[51](https://landlock.io#51)    /// See [erratum 3](https://docs.kernel.org/userspace-api/landlock.html#erratum-3-disconnected-directory-handling).
[52](https://landlock.io#52)    DisconnectedDirectoryHandling = 1 << 2,
[53](https://landlock.io#53)}
[54](https://landlock.io#54)
[55](https://landlock.io#55)impl Erratum {
[56](https://landlock.io#56)    /// Queries the running kernel for fixed errata.
[57](https://landlock.io#57)    ///
[58](https://landlock.io#58)    /// Returns a bitmask of errata that have been fixed in the running
[59](https://landlock.io#59)    /// kernel.  Unknown errata bits from newer kernels are preserved.
[60](https://landlock.io#60)    /// Returns empty if the kernel doesn't support the errata interface.
[61](https://landlock.io#61)    pub fn current() -> BitFlags<Self> {
[62](https://landlock.io#62)        let ret = unsafe {
[63](https://landlock.io#63)            uapi::landlock_create_ruleset(std::ptr::null(), 0, uapi::LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_ERRATA)
[64](https://landlock.io#64)        };
[65](https://landlock.io#65)        if ret >= 0 {
[66](https://landlock.io#66)            // SAFETY: The kernel may return bits unknown to this crate version.
[67](https://landlock.io#67)            // Using from_bits_unchecked to preserve them.
[68](https://landlock.io#68)            unsafe { BitFlags::from_bits_unchecked(ret as u32) }
[69](https://landlock.io#69)        } else {
[70](https://landlock.io#70)            BitFlags::empty()
[71](https://landlock.io#71)        }
[72](https://landlock.io#72)    }
[73](https://landlock.io#73)}
[74](https://landlock.io#74)
[75](https://landlock.io#75)/// Converts an [`ABI`] version into the set of errata applicable to that ABI.
[76](https://landlock.io#76)///
[77](https://landlock.io#77)/// An erratum is applicable if the ABI includes the feature affected by the bug.
[78](https://landlock.io#78)/// For example, [`Erratum::TcpSocketIdentification`] is only applicable to
[79](https://landlock.io#79)/// [`ABI::V4`] and later, since TCP access rights were introduced in that version.
[80](https://landlock.io#80)///
[81](https://landlock.io#81)/// Uses the same incremental accumulation pattern as
[82](https://landlock.io#82)/// [`AccessFs::from_write()`](crate::AccessFs::from_write).
[83](https://landlock.io#83)///
[84](https://landlock.io#84)/// # Stability
[85](https://landlock.io#85)///
[86](https://landlock.io#86)/// The set of errata returned for a given ABI may grow in future versions
[87](https://landlock.io#87)/// of this crate as new kernel bug fixes are identified and backported.
[88](https://landlock.io#88)/// Do not rely on the exact set being stable across crate versions.
[89](https://landlock.io#89)impl From<ABI> for BitFlags<Erratum> {
[90](https://landlock.io#90)    fn from(abi: ABI) -> Self {
[91](https://landlock.io#91)        match abi {
[92](https://landlock.io#92)            ABI::Unsupported => BitFlags::empty(),
[93](https://landlock.io#93)            // Erratum 3: disconnected directory handling (FS, ABI 1+).
[94](https://landlock.io#94)            ABI::V1 | ABI::V2 | ABI::V3 => Erratum::DisconnectedDirectoryHandling.into(),
[95](https://landlock.io#95)            // Erratum 1: TCP socket identification (net, ABI 4+).
[96](https://landlock.io#96)            ABI::V4 | ABI::V5 => Self::from(ABI::V3) | Erratum::TcpSocketIdentification,
[97](https://landlock.io#97)            // Erratum 2: scoped signal handling (scopes, ABI 6+).
[98](https://landlock.io#98)            // When adding a new ABI version without new errata, append it here.
[99](https://landlock.io#99)            ABI::V6 | ABI::V7 => Self::from(ABI::V5) | Erratum::ScopedSignalHandling,
[100](https://landlock.io#100)        }
[101](https://landlock.io#101)    }
[102](https://landlock.io#102)}
[103](https://landlock.io#103)
[104](https://landlock.io#104)/// Extracts the (major, minor, patch, suffix) from /proc/version's
[105](https://landlock.io#105)/// "Linux version X.Y.Z-suffix..." line.
[106](https://landlock.io#106)///
[107](https://landlock.io#107)/// Returns `None` if the input does not start with "Linux version " or if
[108](https://landlock.io#108)/// the major/minor numbers cannot be parsed.  The patch number defaults to
[109](https://landlock.io#109)/// 0 when absent (e.g., for RC kernels).
[110](https://landlock.io#110)#[cfg(test)]
[111](https://landlock.io#111)fn parse_kernel_version(proc_version: &str) -> Option<(u32, u32, u32, &str)> {
[112](https://landlock.io#112)    let after_prefix = proc_version.strip_prefix("Linux version ")?;
[113](https://landlock.io#113)    let token = after_prefix.split_whitespace().next()?;
[114](https://landlock.io#114)    let first_dot = token.find('.')?;
[115](https://landlock.io#115)    let major: u32 = token[..first_dot].parse().ok()?;
[116](https://landlock.io#116)    let rest = &token[first_dot + 1..];
[117](https://landlock.io#117)    let minor_end = rest
[118](https://landlock.io#118)        .find(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_digit())
[119](https://landlock.io#119)        .unwrap_or(rest.len());
[120](https://landlock.io#120)    let minor: u32 = rest[..minor_end].parse().ok()?;
[121](https://landlock.io#121)    let after_minor = &rest[minor_end..];
[122](https://landlock.io#122)    // If a second dot follows, parse the patch number; otherwise default to 0.
[123](https://landlock.io#123)    let (patch, suffix) = match after_minor.strip_prefix('.') {
[124](https://landlock.io#124)        Some(after_dot) => {
[125](https://landlock.io#125)            let patch_end = after_dot
[126](https://landlock.io#126)                .find(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_digit())
[127](https://landlock.io#127)                .unwrap_or(after_dot.len());
[128](https://landlock.io#128)            let patch: u32 = after_dot[..patch_end].parse().unwrap_or(0);
[129](https://landlock.io#129)            (patch, &after_dot[patch_end..])
[130](https://landlock.io#130)        }
[131](https://landlock.io#131)        None => (0, after_minor),
[132](https://landlock.io#132)    };
[133](https://landlock.io#133)    Some((major, minor, patch, suffix))
[134](https://landlock.io#134)}
[135](https://landlock.io#135)
[136](https://landlock.io#136)#[test]
[137](https://landlock.io#137)fn parse_kernel_version_cases() {
[138](https://landlock.io#138)    // Distro-suffixed stable release.
[139](https://landlock.io#139)    assert_eq!(
[140](https://landlock.io#140)        parse_kernel_version("Linux version 6.15.0-29-generic (build@host) ..."),
[141](https://landlock.io#141)        Some((6, 15, 0, "-29-generic")),
[142](https://landlock.io#142)    );
[143](https://landlock.io#143)    // Distro-suffixed older stable.
[144](https://landlock.io#144)    assert_eq!(
[145](https://landlock.io#145)        parse_kernel_version("Linux version 5.10.234-1-amd64 (debian) ..."),
[146](https://landlock.io#146)        Some((5, 10, 234, "-1-amd64")),
[147](https://landlock.io#147)    );
[148](https://landlock.io#148)    // Release candidate without patch number.
[149](https://landlock.io#149)    assert_eq!(
[150](https://landlock.io#150)        parse_kernel_version("Linux version 6.15-rc1 (...)"),
[151](https://landlock.io#151)        Some((6, 15, 0, "-rc1")),
[152](https://landlock.io#152)    );
[153](https://landlock.io#153)    // Bare version with no suffix.
[154](https://landlock.io#154)    assert_eq!(
[155](https://landlock.io#155)        parse_kernel_version("Linux version 6.15"),
[156](https://landlock.io#156)        Some((6, 15, 0, "")),
[157](https://landlock.io#157)    );
[158](https://landlock.io#158)    // Stable patch level with no distro suffix.
[159](https://landlock.io#159)    assert_eq!(
[160](https://landlock.io#160)        parse_kernel_version("Linux version 6.12.5"),
[161](https://landlock.io#161)        Some((6, 12, 5, "")),
[162](https://landlock.io#162)    );
[163](https://landlock.io#163)    // Missing prefix.
[164](https://landlock.io#164)    assert_eq!(parse_kernel_version(""), None);
[165](https://landlock.io#165)    assert_eq!(parse_kernel_version("Some other text"), None);
[166](https://landlock.io#166)    // Unparseable version after prefix.
[167](https://landlock.io#167)    assert_eq!(parse_kernel_version("Linux version garbage"), None);
[168](https://landlock.io#168)}
[169](https://landlock.io#169)
[170](https://landlock.io#170)/// Returns the set of errata that have not been backported yet for a given
[171](https://landlock.io#171)/// kernel version.
[172](https://landlock.io#172)///
[173](https://landlock.io#173)/// This is the single source of truth for known backport gaps.  The version
[174](https://landlock.io#174)/// is the (major, minor, patch, suffix) parsed from /proc/version.
[175](https://landlock.io#175)/// Backports are made per kernel version (not per Landlock ABI), so this
[176](https://landlock.io#176)/// lookup is keyed by kernel version.  The patch number and distro suffix
[177](https://landlock.io#177)/// allow narrowing to specific kernel builds when a fix arrives in a stable
[178](https://landlock.io#178)/// patch level or distro-specific backport.  When an erratum is backported
[179](https://landlock.io#179)/// to a kernel version, remove it from the corresponding match arm.  The
[180](https://landlock.io#180)/// CI will catch mismatches.
[181](https://landlock.io#181)#[cfg(test)]
[182](https://landlock.io#182)fn not_backported_yet(version: (u32, u32, u32, &str)) -> BitFlags<Erratum> {
[183](https://landlock.io#183)    match version {
[184](https://landlock.io#184)        // TODO: erratum 3 (DisconnectedDirectoryHandling) should be backported.
[185](https://landlock.io#185)        (5, 15, _, _) | (6, 1, _, _) => Erratum::DisconnectedDirectoryHandling.into(),
[186](https://landlock.io#186)
[187](https://landlock.io#187)        // 6.15: errata 1 and 2 backported.
[188](https://landlock.io#188)        // TODO: erratum 3 (DisconnectedDirectoryHandling) should be backported.
[189](https://landlock.io#189)        (6, 15, _, _) => Erratum::DisconnectedDirectoryHandling.into(),
[190](https://landlock.io#190)
[191](https://landlock.io#191)        // 6.4, 6.7, 6.10: EOL, no errata interface on stable.kernel.
[192](https://landlock.io#192)        // 6.12: all errata backported.
[193](https://landlock.io#193)        // Future or unknown kernel: assume all errata backported.
[194](https://landlock.io#194)        _ => BitFlags::empty(),
[195](https://landlock.io#195)    }
[196](https://landlock.io#196)}
[197](https://landlock.io#197)
[198](https://landlock.io#198)#[test]
[199](https://landlock.io#199)fn errata_query() {
[200](https://landlock.io#200)    // Verifies the syscall wrapper works on any kernel.
[201](https://landlock.io#201)    let _errata = Erratum::current();
[202](https://landlock.io#202)}
[203](https://landlock.io#203)
[204](https://landlock.io#204)#[test]
[205](https://landlock.io#205)fn errata_up_to_date() {
[206](https://landlock.io#206)    use crate::compat::{ABI, TEST_ABI, TEST_ABI_ENV_NAME};
[207](https://landlock.io#207)
[208](https://landlock.io#208)    // Print /proc/version for diagnostic info when this test runs in CI.
[209](https://landlock.io#209)    let proc_version = std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/version").unwrap_or_default();
[210](https://landlock.io#210)    eprintln!("/proc/version: {}", proc_version.trim());
[211](https://landlock.io#211)
[212](https://landlock.io#212)    // This test requires LANDLOCK_CRATE_TEST_ABI to be explicitly set because
[213](https://landlock.io#213)    // the errata assertions are tied to specific CI kernel versions.  Without
[214](https://landlock.io#214)    // it, TEST_ABI is auto-detected from the running kernel, but From<i32>
[215](https://landlock.io#215)    // maps unknown ABI versions to the highest known one, making the
[216](https://landlock.io#216)    // ABI-to-kernel mapping ambiguous (e.g., a 6.15 kernel maps to V6 before
[217](https://landlock.io#217)    // ABI::V7 exists).  Since Erratum::current() queries the real kernel, the
[218](https://landlock.io#218)    // expected errata for the declared ABI may not match.
[219](https://landlock.io#219)    if std::env::var(TEST_ABI_ENV_NAME).is_err() {
[220](https://landlock.io#220)        eprintln!("Skipping errata_up_to_date: {} not set", TEST_ABI_ENV_NAME,);
[221](https://landlock.io#221)        return;
[222](https://landlock.io#222)    }
[223](https://landlock.io#223)
[224](https://landlock.io#224)    let kernel_version =
[225](https://landlock.io#225)        parse_kernel_version(&proc_version).expect("Failed to parse /proc/version");
[226](https://landlock.io#226)    eprintln!("Parsed kernel version: {:?}", kernel_version);
[227](https://landlock.io#227)
[228](https://landlock.io#228)    let current = Erratum::current();
[229](https://landlock.io#229)    let applicable: BitFlags<Erratum> = (*TEST_ABI).into();
[230](https://landlock.io#230)    let expected = applicable & !not_backported_yet(kernel_version);
[231](https://landlock.io#231)
[232](https://landlock.io#232)    // Kernel must never report errata for features absent from this ABI.
[233](https://landlock.io#233)    assert!(
[234](https://landlock.io#234)        current & !applicable == BitFlags::empty(),
[235](https://landlock.io#235)        "kernel reported errata not applicable to ABI {:?}: {:?}",
[236](https://landlock.io#236)        *TEST_ABI,
[237](https://landlock.io#237)        current & !applicable,
[238](https://landlock.io#238)    );
[239](https://landlock.io#239)
[240](https://landlock.io#240)    match *TEST_ABI {
[241](https://landlock.io#241)        ABI::Unsupported => assert!(current.is_empty()),
[242](https://landlock.io#242)        ABI::V1 | ABI::V2 => assert_eq!(current, expected),
[243](https://landlock.io#243)        // 6.4, 6.7, 6.10: EOL, no errata interface on stable.kernel.
[244](https://landlock.io#244)        ABI::V3 | ABI::V4 | ABI::V5 => {}
[245](https://landlock.io#245)        ABI::V6 | ABI::V7 => assert_eq!(current, expected),
[246](https://landlock.io#246)    }
[247](https://landlock.io#247)}

[262](#262)where
[263](#263)    T: std::error::Error,
[264](#264){
[265](#265)    fn from(error: T) -> Self {
[266](#266)        let default = libc::EINVAL;
[267](#267)        if let Some(e) = error.source() {
[268](#268)            if let Some(e) = e.downcast_ref::<std::io::Error>() {
[269](#269)                return Errno(e.raw_os_error().unwrap_or(default));
[270](#270)            }
[271](#271)        }
[272](#272)        Errno(default)
[273](#273)    }

[284](#284)#[cfg(test)]
[285](#285)fn _test_ruleset_errno(expected_errno: c_int) {
[286](#286)    use std::io::Error;
[287](#287)
[288](#288)    let handle_access_err = RulesetError::HandleAccesses(HandleAccessesError::Fs(
[289](#289)        HandleAccessError::Compat(CompatError::Access(AccessError::Empty)),
[290](#290)    ));
[291](#291)    assert_eq!(*Errno::from(handle_access_err), libc::EINVAL);
[292](#292)
[293](#293)    let create_ruleset_err = RulesetError::CreateRuleset(CreateRulesetError::CreateRulesetCall {
[294](#294)        source: Error::from_raw_os_error(expected_errno),
[295](#295)    });
[296](#296)    assert_eq!(*Errno::from(create_ruleset_err), expected_errno);
[297](#297)
[298](#298)    let add_rules_fs_err = RulesetError::AddRules(AddRulesError::Fs(AddRuleError::AddRuleCall {
[299](#299)        source: Error::from_raw_os_error(expected_errno),
[300](#300)    }));
[301](#301)    assert_eq!(*Errno::from(add_rules_fs_err), expected_errno);
[302](#302)
[303](#303)    let add_rules_net_err = RulesetError::AddRules(AddRulesError::Net(AddRuleError::AddRuleCall {
[304](#304)        source: Error::from_raw_os_error(expected_errno),
[305](#305)    }));
[306](#306)    assert_eq!(*Errno::from(add_rules_net_err), expected_errno);
[307](#307)
[308](#308)    let add_rules_other_err =
[309](#309)        RulesetError::AddRules(AddRulesError::Fs(AddRuleError::UnhandledAccess {
[310](#310)            access: AccessFs::Execute.into(),
[311](#311)            incompatible: BitFlags::<AccessFs>::EMPTY,
[312](#312)        }));
[313](#313)    assert_eq!(*Errno::from(add_rules_other_err), libc::EINVAL);
[314](#314)
[315](#315)    let restrict_self_err = RulesetError::RestrictSelf(RestrictSelfError::RestrictSelfCall {
[316](#316)        source: Error::from_raw_os_error(expected_errno),
[317](#317)    });
[318](#318)    assert_eq!(*Errno::from(restrict_self_err), expected_errno);
[319](#319)
[320](#320)    let set_no_new_privs_err = RulesetError::RestrictSelf(RestrictSelfError::SetNoNewPrivsCall {
[321](#321)        source: Error::from_raw_os_error(expected_errno),
[322](#322)    });
[323](#323)    assert_eq!(*Errno::from(set_no_new_privs_err), expected_errno);
[324](#324)
[325](#325)    let create_ruleset_missing_err =
[326](#326)        RulesetError::CreateRuleset(CreateRulesetError::MissingHandledAccess);
[327](#327)    assert_eq!(*Errno::from(create_ruleset_missing_err), libc::EINVAL);
[328](#328)
[329](#329)    let restrict_self_flags_err = RulesetError::RestrictSelfFlags(SyscallFlagError::NotSupported {
[330](#330)        flag: RestrictSelfFlag::LogSameExec,
[331](#331)        set: false,
[332](#332)    });
[333](#333)    assert_eq!(*Errno::from(restrict_self_flags_err), libc::EINVAL);
[334](#334)}

[52](#52)impl Access for AccessNet {
[57](#57)    fn from_all(abi: ABI) -> BitFlags<Self> {
[58](#58)        match abi {
[59](#59)            ABI::Unsupported | ABI::V1 | ABI::V2 | ABI::V3 => BitFlags::EMPTY,
[60](#60)            ABI::V4 | ABI::V5 | ABI::V6 | ABI::V7 => AccessNet::BindTcp | AccessNet::ConnectTcp,
[61](#61)        }
[62](#62)    }

[65](#65)impl HandledAccess for AccessNet {}
[66](#66)
[67](#67)impl PrivateHandledAccess for AccessNet {
[68](#68)    fn ruleset_handle_access(
[69](#69)        ruleset: &mut Ruleset,
[70](#70)        access: BitFlags<Self>,
[71](#71)    ) -> Result<(), HandleAccessesError> {
[72](#72)        ruleset.requested_handled_net |= access;
[74](#74)        ruleset.actual_handled_net |= match access
[75](#75)            .try_compat(
[76](#76)                ruleset.compat.abi(),
[77](#77)                ruleset.compat.level,
[78](#78)                &mut ruleset.compat.state,
[79](#79)            )
[80](#80)            .map_err(HandleAccessError::Compat)?
[81](#81)        {
[82](#82)            Some(a) => a,
[83](#83)            None => return Ok(()),
[84](#84)        };
[85](#85)        Ok(())
[86](#86)    }
[87](#87)
[88](#88)    fn into_add_rules_error(error: AddRuleError<Self>) -> AddRulesError {
[89](#89)        AddRulesError::Net(error)
[90](#90)    }
[91](#91)
[92](#92)    fn into_handle_accesses_error(error: HandleAccessError<Self>) -> HandleAccessesError {
[93](#93)        HandleAccessesError::Net(error)
[94](#94)    }

[141](#141)    const TYPE_ID: uapi::landlock_rule_type = uapi::landlock_rule_type_LANDLOCK_RULE_NET_PORT;
[142](#142)
[143](#143)    fn as_ptr(&mut self) -> *const libc::c_void {
[144](#144)        self.attr.port = self.port as u64;
[145](#145)        self.attr.allowed_access = self.allowed_access.bits();
[146](#146)        &self.attr as *const _ as _
[147](#147)    }
[148](#148)
[149](#149)    fn check_consistency(&self, ruleset: &RulesetCreated) -> Result<(), AddRulesError> {
[150](#150)        if ruleset.requested_handled_net.contains(self.allowed_access) {
[155](#155)            Ok(())
[156](#156)        } else {
[157](#157)            Err(AddRuleError::UnhandledAccess {
[158](#158)                access: self.allowed_access,
[159](#159)                incompatible: self.allowed_access & !ruleset.requested_handled_net,
[160](#160)            }
[161](#161)            .into())
[162](#162)        }
[163](#163)    }
[164](#164)}
[165](#165)
[166](#166)#[test]
[167](#167)fn net_port_check_consistency() {
[168](#168)    use crate::*;
[169](#169)
[170](#170)    let bind = AccessNet::BindTcp;
[171](#171)    let bind_connect = bind | AccessNet::ConnectTcp;
[172](#172)
[173](#173)    assert!(matches!(
[174](#174)        Ruleset::from(ABI::Unsupported)
[175](#175)            .handle_access(bind)
[176](#176)            .unwrap()
[177](#177)            .create()

[179](#179)            .add_rule(NetPort::new(1, bind_connect))
[180](#180)            .unwrap_err(),
[181](#181)        RulesetError::AddRules(AddRulesError::Net(AddRuleError::UnhandledAccess { access, incompatible }))
[182](#182)            if access == bind_connect && incompatible == AccessNet::ConnectTcp
[183](#183)    ));

[186](#186)impl TryCompat<AccessNet> for NetPort {

[188](#188)        mut self,
[189](#189)        abi: ABI,
[190](#190)        parent_level: L,
[191](#191)        compat_state: &mut CompatState,
[192](#192)    ) -> Result<Option<Self>, CompatError<AccessNet>>
[193](#193)    where
[194](#194)        L: Into<CompatLevel>,
[195](#195)    {
[196](#196)        self.allowed_access = match self.allowed_access.try_compat(
[198](#198)            abi,
[199](#199)            self.tailored_compat_level(parent_level),
[200](#200)            compat_state,
[201](#201)        )? {
[202](#202)            Some(a) => a,
[203](#203)            None => return Ok(None),
[204](#204)        };
[205](#205)        Ok(Some(self))
[206](#206)    }
[207](#207)
[208](#208)    fn try_compat_inner(
[209](#209)        &mut self,
[210](#210)        _abi: ABI,
[211](#211)    ) -> Result<CompatResult<AccessNet>, CompatError<AccessNet>> {

# restrict_self.rs - source

# landlock/restrict_self.rs

[1](https://landlock.io#1)// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
[2](https://landlock.io#2)
[3](https://landlock.io#3)//! Restrict_self flag configuration.
[4](https://landlock.io#4)//!
[5](https://landlock.io#5)//! The [`RestrictSelfAttr`] trait provides the
[6](https://landlock.io#6)//! [`log_subdomains()`](RestrictSelfAttr::log_subdomains) setter shared
[7](https://landlock.io#7)//! between [`RulesetCreated`](crate::RulesetCreated) (with a domain) and
[8](https://landlock.io#8)//! [`RestrictSelf`] (without a domain).
[9](https://landlock.io#9)//!
[10](https://landlock.io#10)//! Domain-specific setters ([`log_same_exec()`](crate::RulesetCreatedAttr::log_same_exec),
[11](https://landlock.io#11)//! [`log_new_exec()`](crate::RulesetCreatedAttr::log_new_exec)) are on
[12](https://landlock.io#12)//! [`RulesetCreatedAttr`](crate::RulesetCreatedAttr) which requires
[13](https://landlock.io#13)//! `RestrictSelfAttr` as a supertrait.
[14](https://landlock.io#14)
[15](https://landlock.io#15)use crate::compat::private::OptionCompatLevelMut;
[16](https://landlock.io#16)use crate::compat::Compatibility;
[17](https://landlock.io#17)use crate::flags::{RestrictSelfFlag, SyscallFlagExt};
[18](https://landlock.io#18)use crate::prctl::try_set_no_new_privs;
[19](https://landlock.io#19)use crate::{
[20](https://landlock.io#20)    uapi, CompatLevel, CompatState, Compatible, LandlockStatus, RestrictSelfError, RulesetError,
[21](https://landlock.io#21)};
[22](https://landlock.io#22)use private::RestrictSelfFlagsState;
[23](https://landlock.io#23)
[24](https://landlock.io#24)#[cfg(test)]
[25](https://landlock.io#25)use crate::ABI;
[26](https://landlock.io#26)
[27](https://landlock.io#27)pub(crate) mod private {
[28](https://landlock.io#28)    use crate::RulesetError;
[29](https://landlock.io#29)
[30](https://landlock.io#30)    /// Private plumbing trait for types that store restrict_self flags.
[31](https://landlock.io#31)    ///
[32](https://landlock.io#32)    /// Follows the same pattern as
[33](https://landlock.io#33)    /// [`OptionCompatLevelMut`](crate::compat::private::OptionCompatLevelMut)
[34](https://landlock.io#34)    /// for [`Compatible`](crate::Compatible).
[35](https://landlock.io#35)    ///
[36](https://landlock.io#36)    /// The `try_set_flag()` method encapsulates all internal state access
[37](https://landlock.io#37)    /// (requested/actual flags and compat state) to avoid exposing
[38](https://landlock.io#38)    /// `pub(crate)` types in the trait interface.
[39](https://landlock.io#39)    pub trait RestrictSelfFlagsState {
[40](https://landlock.io#40)        fn try_set_flag(
[41](https://landlock.io#41)            &mut self,
[42](https://landlock.io#42)            flag: super::RestrictSelfFlag,
[43](https://landlock.io#43)            set: bool,
[44](https://landlock.io#44)        ) -> Result<(), RulesetError>;
[45](https://landlock.io#45)    }
[46](https://landlock.io#46)}
[47](https://landlock.io#47)
[48](https://landlock.io#48)/// Trait for types that accept restrict_self flag configuration.
[49](https://landlock.io#49)///
[50](https://landlock.io#50)/// Provides [`log_subdomains()`](Self::log_subdomains) which works both
[51](https://landlock.io#51)/// with and without a Landlock domain.
[52](https://landlock.io#52)///
[53](https://landlock.io#53)/// Implemented by [`RulesetCreated`](crate::RulesetCreated) (via
[54](https://landlock.io#54)/// [`RulesetCreatedAttr`](crate::RulesetCreatedAttr) supertrait) and
[55](https://landlock.io#55)/// [`RestrictSelf`].
[56](https://landlock.io#56)///
[57](https://landlock.io#57)/// Domain-specific setters (`log_same_exec`, `log_new_exec`) are on
[58](https://landlock.io#58)/// [`RulesetCreatedAttr`](crate::RulesetCreatedAttr).
[59](https://landlock.io#59)pub trait RestrictSelfAttr: Sized + private::RestrictSelfFlagsState {
[60](https://landlock.io#60)    /// Controls logging of denied accesses from nested Landlock domains.
[61](https://landlock.io#61)    /// Logging is **enabled** by default.  See the
[62](https://landlock.io#62)    /// [kernel documentation](https://docs.kernel.org/userspace-api/landlock.html#enforcing-a-ruleset).
[63](https://landlock.io#63)    ///
[64](https://landlock.io#64)    /// Calling with `false` sets the `LANDLOCK_RESTRICT_SELF_LOG_SUBDOMAINS_OFF` flag.
[65](https://landlock.io#65)    /// Setters are last-call-wins: calling again with a different boolean
[66](https://landlock.io#66)    /// re-configures the flag (e.g., `log_subdomains(false).log_subdomains(true)`
[67](https://landlock.io#67)    /// leaves logging enabled).
[68](https://landlock.io#68)    ///
[69](https://landlock.io#69)    /// Setting to the default value never triggers a compatibility check,
[70](https://landlock.io#70)    /// so it cannot error even under
[71](https://landlock.io#71)    /// [`CompatLevel::HardRequirement`](crate::CompatLevel::HardRequirement)
[72](https://landlock.io#72)    /// on an unsupported kernel.
[73](https://landlock.io#73)    ///
[74](https://landlock.io#74)    /// Available since Landlock [ABI v7](crate::ABI::V7).
[75](https://landlock.io#75)    ///
[76](https://landlock.io#76)    /// On error, returns a wrapped
[77](https://landlock.io#77)    /// [`SyscallFlagError<RestrictSelfFlag>`](crate::SyscallFlagError).
[78](https://landlock.io#78)    fn log_subdomains(mut self, set: bool) -> Result<Self, RulesetError> {
[79](https://landlock.io#79)        self.try_set_flag(RestrictSelfFlag::LogSubdomains, set)?;
[80](https://landlock.io#80)        Ok(self)
[81](https://landlock.io#81)    }
[82](https://landlock.io#82)}
[83](https://landlock.io#83)
[84](https://landlock.io#84)/// Builder for calling `landlock_restrict_self()` without creating a
[85](https://landlock.io#85)/// Landlock domain.
[86](https://landlock.io#86)///
[87](https://landlock.io#87)/// Use this when you want to configure `landlock_restrict_self()` flags
[88](https://landlock.io#88)/// without creating a ruleset or a Landlock domain (e.g., muting
[89](https://landlock.io#89)/// subdomain audit logs for nested domains).
[90](https://landlock.io#90)///
[91](https://landlock.io#91)/// Only [`log_subdomains()`](RestrictSelfAttr::log_subdomains) is available
[92](https://landlock.io#92)/// on this builder.  Domain-specific setters
[93](https://landlock.io#93)/// ([`log_same_exec()`](crate::RulesetCreatedAttr::log_same_exec),
[94](https://landlock.io#94)/// [`log_new_exec()`](crate::RulesetCreatedAttr::log_new_exec)) require a
[95](https://landlock.io#95)/// Landlock domain via [`RulesetCreated`](crate::RulesetCreated).
[96](https://landlock.io#96)///
[97](https://landlock.io#97)/// Available since Landlock [ABI v7](crate::ABI::V7).
[98](https://landlock.io#98)///
[99](https://landlock.io#99)/// `no_new_privs` is enforced by default; call
[100](https://landlock.io#100)/// [`no_new_privs(false)`](Self::no_new_privs) to opt out.
[101](https://landlock.io#101)///
[102](https://landlock.io#102)/// # Example
[103](https://landlock.io#103)///
[104](https://landlock.io#104)/// ```no_run
[105](https://landlock.io#105)/// use landlock::*;
[106](https://landlock.io#106)///
[107](https://landlock.io#107)/// let status = RestrictSelf::default()
[108](https://landlock.io#108)///     .log_subdomains(false)?
[109](https://landlock.io#109)///     .apply()?;
[110](https://landlock.io#110)/// println!("Landlock status: {:?}", status.landlock);
[111](https://landlock.io#111)/// # Ok::<(), RulesetError>(())
[112](https://landlock.io#112)/// ```
[113](https://landlock.io#113)///
[114](https://landlock.io#114)/// Use [`set_compatibility()`](Compatible::set_compatibility) to control
[115](https://landlock.io#115)/// how unsupported flags are handled.
[116](https://landlock.io#116)///
[117](https://landlock.io#117)/// [`apply()`](Self::apply) returns a [`RestrictSelfStatus`] with the
[118](https://landlock.io#118)/// Landlock support status and the effective flag states.  Its name
[119](https://landlock.io#119)/// differs from [`RulesetCreated::restrict_self()`](crate::RulesetCreated::restrict_self)
[120](https://landlock.io#120)/// to avoid the redundant `RestrictSelf::restrict_self()`.
[121](https://landlock.io#121)#[derive(Debug)]
[122](https://landlock.io#122)pub struct RestrictSelf {
[123](https://landlock.io#123)    requested_flags: u32,
[124](https://landlock.io#124)    actual_flags: u32,
[125](https://landlock.io#125)    no_new_privs: bool,
[126](https://landlock.io#126)    compat: Compatibility,
[127](https://landlock.io#127)}
[128](https://landlock.io#128)
[129](https://landlock.io#129)impl Default for RestrictSelf {
[130](https://landlock.io#130)    /// Returns a new `RestrictSelf`.
[131](https://landlock.io#131)    /// This call automatically probes the running kernel to know if it
[132](https://landlock.io#132)    /// supports Landlock.
[133](https://landlock.io#133)    fn default() -> Self {
[134](https://landlock.io#134)        Self {
[135](https://landlock.io#135)            requested_flags: 0,
[136](https://landlock.io#136)            actual_flags: 0,
[137](https://landlock.io#137)            no_new_privs: true,
[138](https://landlock.io#138)            compat: Compatibility::new(),
[139](https://landlock.io#139)        }
[140](https://landlock.io#140)    }
[141](https://landlock.io#141)}
[142](https://landlock.io#142)
[143](https://landlock.io#143)#[cfg(test)]
[144](https://landlock.io#144)impl From<ABI> for RestrictSelf {
[145](https://landlock.io#145)    fn from(abi: ABI) -> Self {
[146](https://landlock.io#146)        Self {
[147](https://landlock.io#147)            requested_flags: 0,
[148](https://landlock.io#148)            actual_flags: 0,
[149](https://landlock.io#149)            no_new_privs: true,
[150](https://landlock.io#150)            compat: Compatibility::from(abi),
[151](https://landlock.io#151)        }
[152](https://landlock.io#152)    }
[153](https://landlock.io#153)}
[154](https://landlock.io#154)
[155](https://landlock.io#155)impl RestrictSelfFlagsState for RestrictSelf {
[156](https://landlock.io#156)    fn try_set_flag(&mut self, flag: RestrictSelfFlag, set: bool) -> Result<(), RulesetError> {
[157](https://landlock.io#157)        let raw_bit = flag.raw_bit();
[158](https://landlock.io#158)        // Last-call-wins: requested tracks non-default user intent, actual
[159](https://landlock.io#159)        // tracks the bit that will be passed to the kernel.
[160](https://landlock.io#160)        //
[161](https://landlock.io#161)        // requested_flags is updated unconditionally; actual_flags is
[162](https://landlock.io#162)        // updated only if try_compat succeeds.  On HardRequirement +
[163](https://landlock.io#163)        // unsupported, try_compat returns Err and requested_flags is
[164](https://landlock.io#164)        // left in a "user requested this" state; the builder is consumed
[165](https://landlock.io#165)        // by `?` on error so this inconsistency is not observable.
[166](https://landlock.io#166)        if set == flag.default_value() {
[167](https://landlock.io#167)            self.requested_flags &= !raw_bit;
[168](https://landlock.io#168)        } else {
[169](https://landlock.io#169)            self.requested_flags |= raw_bit;
[170](https://landlock.io#170)        }
[171](https://landlock.io#171)        if flag.try_compat(set, &mut self.compat)? {
[172](https://landlock.io#172)            self.actual_flags |= raw_bit;
[173](https://landlock.io#173)        } else {
[174](https://landlock.io#174)            self.actual_flags &= !raw_bit;
[175](https://landlock.io#175)        }
[176](https://landlock.io#176)        Ok(())
[177](https://landlock.io#177)    }
[178](https://landlock.io#178)}
[179](https://landlock.io#179)
[180](https://landlock.io#180)impl RestrictSelfAttr for RestrictSelf {}
[181](https://landlock.io#181)
[182](https://landlock.io#182)impl OptionCompatLevelMut for RestrictSelf {
[183](https://landlock.io#183)    fn as_option_compat_level_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Option<CompatLevel> {
[184](https://landlock.io#184)        &mut self.compat.level
[185](https://landlock.io#185)    }
[186](https://landlock.io#186)}
[187](https://landlock.io#187)
[188](https://landlock.io#188)impl Compatible for RestrictSelf {}
[189](https://landlock.io#189)
[190](https://landlock.io#190)/// Status returned by [`RestrictSelf::apply()`].
[191](https://landlock.io#191)///
[192](https://landlock.io#192)/// This is a proper subset of [`RestrictionStatus`](crate::RestrictionStatus):
[193](https://landlock.io#193)/// `log_same_exec` and `log_new_exec` are domain-specific and not configurable
[194](https://landlock.io#194)/// on [`RestrictSelf`], so they are not reported here; `ruleset` does not
[195](https://landlock.io#195)/// apply without a domain.
[196](https://landlock.io#196)#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
[197](https://landlock.io#197)#[non_exhaustive]
[198](https://landlock.io#198)pub struct RestrictSelfStatus {
[199](https://landlock.io#199)    /// Landlock support status of the running system.
[200](https://landlock.io#200)    pub landlock: LandlockStatus,
[201](https://landlock.io#201)    /// `no_new_privs` was successfully enforced via
[202](https://landlock.io#202)    /// `prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1)`.
[203](https://landlock.io#203)    pub no_new_privs: bool,
[204](https://landlock.io#204)    /// Subdomain logging is enabled (default: true).
[205](https://landlock.io#205)    pub log_subdomains: bool,
[206](https://landlock.io#206)}
[207](https://landlock.io#207)
[208](https://landlock.io#208)impl RestrictSelf {
[209](https://landlock.io#209)    /// Configures whether to call `prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS)` during
[210](https://landlock.io#210)    /// [`apply()`](Self::apply).  Defaults to `true`.
[211](https://landlock.io#211)    ///
[212](https://landlock.io#212)    /// This `prctl(2)` call is never ignored, even if an error was
[213](https://landlock.io#213)    /// encountered while [`CompatLevel::SoftRequirement`] was set.
[214](https://landlock.io#214)    ///
[215](https://landlock.io#215)    /// See [`RestrictSelfAttr::log_subdomains()`] for compat-state
[216](https://landlock.io#216)    /// behavior when toggling this setter on unsupported kernels.
[217](https://landlock.io#217)    pub fn no_new_privs(mut self, yes: bool) -> Self {
[218](https://landlock.io#218)        self.no_new_privs = yes;
[219](https://landlock.io#219)        self
[220](https://landlock.io#220)    }
[221](https://landlock.io#221)
[222](https://landlock.io#222)    /// Applies the configured restrict_self flags by calling
[223](https://landlock.io#223)    /// `landlock_restrict_self(-1, flags)`.
[224](https://landlock.io#224)    ///
[225](https://landlock.io#225)    /// If `no_new_privs` is configured (default), also calls
[226](https://landlock.io#226)    /// `prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1, 0, 0, 0)` first, since the kernel
[227](https://landlock.io#227)    /// requires `no_new_privs` (or `CAP_SYS_ADMIN`) for
[228](https://landlock.io#228)    /// `landlock_restrict_self()`.  See
[229](https://landlock.io#229)    /// [`no_new_privs()`](Self::no_new_privs) to opt out.
[230](https://landlock.io#230)    ///
[231](https://landlock.io#231)    /// Returns a [`RestrictSelfStatus`] with the Landlock support status.
[232](https://landlock.io#232)    /// Skips the restrict_self syscall if no flags are enforceable.
[233](https://landlock.io#233)    pub fn apply(mut self) -> Result<RestrictSelfStatus, RulesetError> {
[234](https://landlock.io#234)        let enforced_nnp = if self.no_new_privs {
[235](https://landlock.io#235)            try_set_no_new_privs(&mut self.compat)?
[236](https://landlock.io#236)        } else {
[237](https://landlock.io#237)            false
[238](https://landlock.io#238)        };
[239](https://landlock.io#239)
[240](https://landlock.io#240)        let log_subdomains = RestrictSelfFlag::LogSubdomains.is_set(self.actual_flags);
[241](https://landlock.io#241)
[242](https://landlock.io#242)        let status = RestrictSelfStatus {
[243](https://landlock.io#243)            landlock: self.compat.status(),
[244](https://landlock.io#244)            no_new_privs: enforced_nnp,
[245](https://landlock.io#245)            log_subdomains,
[246](https://landlock.io#246)        };
[247](https://landlock.io#247)
[248](https://landlock.io#248)        // Skip the syscall when the compat state indicates no features are
[249](https://landlock.io#249)        // enforceable, mirroring RulesetCreated::restrict_self().
[250](https://landlock.io#250)        match self.compat.state {
[251](https://landlock.io#251)            CompatState::Init | CompatState::No | CompatState::Dummy => return Ok(status),
[252](https://landlock.io#252)            CompatState::Full | CompatState::Partial => {
[253](https://landlock.io#253)                if self.actual_flags == 0 {
[254](https://landlock.io#254)                    return Ok(status);
[255](https://landlock.io#255)                }
[256](https://landlock.io#256)            }
[257](https://landlock.io#257)        }
[258](https://landlock.io#258)
[259](https://landlock.io#259)        match unsafe { uapi::landlock_restrict_self(-1, self.actual_flags) } {
[260](https://landlock.io#260)            0 => Ok(status),
[261](https://landlock.io#261)            _ => Err(RestrictSelfError::RestrictSelfCall {
[262](https://landlock.io#262)                source: std::io::Error::last_os_error(),
[263](https://landlock.io#263)            }
[264](https://landlock.io#264)            .into()),
[265](https://landlock.io#265)        }
[266](https://landlock.io#266)    }
[267](https://landlock.io#267)}
[268](https://landlock.io#268)
[269](https://landlock.io#269)#[cfg(test)]
[270](https://landlock.io#270)mod tests {
[271](https://landlock.io#271)    use super::*;
[272](https://landlock.io#272)    use crate::uapi;
[273](https://landlock.io#273)    use crate::*;
[274](https://landlock.io#274)
[275](https://landlock.io#275)    #[test]
[276](https://landlock.io#276)    fn restrict_self_default() {
[277](https://landlock.io#277)        let rs = RestrictSelf::default();
[278](https://landlock.io#278)        assert_eq!(rs.requested_flags, 0);
[279](https://landlock.io#279)        assert_eq!(rs.actual_flags, 0);
[280](https://landlock.io#280)
[281](https://landlock.io#281)        // apply() on an unconfigured RestrictSelf returns the kernel's default
[282](https://landlock.io#282)        // flag states.  The compat state is Init, so no real syscall is made.
[283](https://landlock.io#283)        let status = rs.apply().unwrap();
[284](https://landlock.io#284)        assert!(status.log_subdomains);
[285](https://landlock.io#285)    }
[286](https://landlock.io#286)
[287](https://landlock.io#287)    #[test]
[288](https://landlock.io#288)    fn restrict_self_log_subdomains() {
[289](https://landlock.io#289)        // With mocked V7: flag should be set.
[290](https://landlock.io#290)        // TODO: Add real kernel test with audit parsing for end-to-end validation.
[291](https://landlock.io#291)        let rs = RestrictSelf {
[292](https://landlock.io#292)            requested_flags: 0,
[293](https://landlock.io#293)            actual_flags: 0,
[294](https://landlock.io#294)            no_new_privs: true,
[295](https://landlock.io#295)            compat: ABI::V7.into(),
[296](https://landlock.io#296)        };
[297](https://landlock.io#297)        let rs = rs.log_subdomains(false).unwrap();
[298](https://landlock.io#298)        assert_ne!(rs.requested_flags, 0);
[299](https://landlock.io#299)        assert_ne!(rs.actual_flags, 0);
[300](https://landlock.io#300)        assert_eq!(rs.requested_flags, rs.actual_flags);
[301](https://landlock.io#301)    }
[302](https://landlock.io#302)
[303](https://landlock.io#303)    #[test]
[304](https://landlock.io#304)    fn restrict_self_compatibility() {
[305](https://landlock.io#305)        // HardRequirement on unsupported ABI returns error.
[306](https://landlock.io#306)        let rs = RestrictSelf {
[307](https://landlock.io#307)            requested_flags: 0,
[308](https://landlock.io#308)            actual_flags: 0,
[309](https://landlock.io#309)            no_new_privs: true,
[310](https://landlock.io#310)            compat: ABI::Unsupported.into(),
[311](https://landlock.io#311)        };
[312](https://landlock.io#312)        assert!(matches!(
[313](https://landlock.io#313)            rs.set_compatibility(CompatLevel::HardRequirement)
[314](https://landlock.io#314)                .log_subdomains(false)

[316](https://landlock.io#316)            RulesetError::RestrictSelfFlags(SyscallFlagError::NotSupported {
[317](https://landlock.io#317)                flag: RestrictSelfFlag::LogSubdomains,
[318](https://landlock.io#318)                set: false,
[319](https://landlock.io#319)            })
[320](https://landlock.io#320)        ));
[321](https://landlock.io#321)    }

[431](https://landlock.io#431)            requested_flags: 0,

[448](https://landlock.io#448)        // so HardRequirement on an unsupported ABI does not error.
[449](https://landlock.io#449)        let rs = RestrictSelf {
[450](https://landlock.io#450)            requested_flags: 0,

[457](https://landlock.io#457)            .log_subdomains(true)

[459](https://landlock.io#459)        assert_eq!(rs.requested_flags, 0);
[460](https://landlock.io#460)        assert_eq!(rs.actual_flags, 0);
[461](https://landlock.io#461)    }

[464](https://landlock.io#464)    fn restrict_self_no_nnp() {
[465](https://landlock.io#465)        // With no_new_privs(false) and Unsupported (state Init, syscall
[466](https://landlock.io#466)        // skipped), apply() reports no_new_privs: false without calling
[467](https://landlock.io#467)        // prctl.
[468](https://landlock.io#468)        let rs = RestrictSelf {
